summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted from bariatric surgery clinic with recurrent severe abdominal pain and nausea. She has a history of gastrojejunal ulcers and gastritis. On admission, she was started on IV pantoprazole and pain management, with successful transition to oral medications. Tube feeds were restarted and tolerated well. A PICC line was placed on hospital day 2 to facilitate home IV pantoprazole therapy, with placement confirmed by chest X-ray. Her pain improved significantly, and she was discharged home with instructions for PICC care, medication continuation, and follow-up in the surgery clinic. She remained stable throughout her stay with no complications.
